<!-- pr-reviewer: 9ff4d7b3055fe57932d30826b4e2e2c054d72842 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The review found no blocking items. The change meets issue #2422.

- Both tests run the public CLI pipeline. They compare the complete output with the shipped NC file.
- The tests belong in the app crate. They have a provenance comment and a gate map.
- The decision file explains the choice. The PR changes no product code, dependencies, process files, or UI files.

Local results, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `ee49b068063de07a9bf6af0d7ea2a99e40766e2a`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` | Selects only `first_part_programs` |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test first_part_programs --no-run -j 6` | Pass |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test first_part_programs -j 6 -- --nocapture` | 2 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings` | Pass |

Both CLI verification reports show `ok: true`, no gate problems, and no operation warnings.

This is a safety-tier review because the PR changes shipped G-code. I checked all 369 mill NC lines and all 151 router NC lines. I checked the units, tool order, coordinates, depths, feeds, arcs, retracts, drill cycles, and program ends against the project parameters. The mill changes include explicit metric units, decimal formatting, clearance moves, helical pocket entries, and separate drill cycles. The router program includes the drill group, two pocket depths, and the contour with four tab bypasses. No CL golden changed.

I repeated both mutations in the review worktree:

1. I replaced the mill NC with the file from upstream/main. `first_part_posts_the_shipped_program` failed with exit 101 and the stale-file message. After restoration, it passed.
2. I removed the router NC. `first_router_part_posts_the_shipped_program` failed with exit 101 and the missing-file message. After restoration, it passed.

Requested before merge: none.

Limits: Linux local checks only. No physical machine run, Windows run, GUI run, or release gate was performed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
